sloka: अस्माकम् विहिता वृत्तिः निसार्गेण च दूरतः ।विहिता पाद मूले तु वृत्तिः चरण योधिनाम् ॥४-५८-३३॥
transliteration: asmākam vihitā vṛttiḥ nisārgeṇa ca dūrataḥ ।vihitā pāda mūle tu vṛttiḥ caraṇa yodhinām ॥4-58-33॥

translations.english: The despicable deed was done by that flesh-eating demon, and avenging my brother's enmity falls to me.
